feeds.title: NYC Single Mom Blog
feeds.description: Linda Grant, the creative force behind NYC Single Mom.com curates a lifestyle site brimming with entertainment, travel, tech, and lifestyle products. As a family lifestyle and adoptive parenting expert, she shares invaluable parenting tips, dining recommendations, travel insights, and NYC-centric events. Through her expertise, advocacy, and brand partnerships, Linda empowers readers with practical solutions for everyday challenges, enriching their lives with useful information and products.

feeds.title: Single Mom Defined
feeds.description: SingleMomDefined.com stands as a premier online hub for single parenting guidance. Offering personal essays and articles on diverse topics, it redefines the narrative about Black single moms, fostering an inclusive, supportive community. Through an interactive resource directory and in-person activities like Advocacy Actions and Self-Care Squad, it empowers single moms with resources, advocacy, and camaraderie.

feeds.title: Amandasway Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Amandasway, where lifestyle blogger Amanda shares her eclectic interests. From recipes to parenting, travel, style, beauty, and home, she offers a diverse array of content. With personal anecdotes and insights, Amanda invites readers to connect with her experiences and find resonance in her versatile blog.

feeds.title: Single Black Motherhood Blog
feeds.description: Kim, a 26-year-old working mother, shares her single Black motherhood journey on Single Black Motherhood. Through podcasting and blogging, she offers insights, tips, and inspiration to fellow moms. Kim's enthusiasm for connecting and uplifting others shines through as she navigates the challenges and joys of parenting with honesty and grace.

feeds.title: Kaywanda Lamb Blog
feeds.description: Kaywanda Lamb, author, speaker, and blogger known as The Winning Single Mom, empowers single mothers on their parenting journey. Through coaching and resources, she guides moms to raise exceptional children while transforming their own lives. Her articles cover single parenting, date ideas, family savings, and lifestyle tips, offering practical wisdom and encouragement to fellow single parents.

feeds.title: Single Moms Planet Blog
feeds.description: Single Moms Planet, founded by model and TV personality Neferteri Plessy, is a beacon of empowerment for single mothers. Through comprehensive programs in financial literacy, business development, and mentorship, they uplift under-resourced children by educating their mothers. Neferteri's personal experience drives their mission to support single mothers in overcoming unique challenges and achieving success in both career and family life.

feeds.title: Nakisha Wynn Blog
feeds.description: Nakisha Wynn, an Orlando-based family lifestyle blog, empowers single working moms to thrive in every aspect of life. From single parenting to entrepreneurship, she shares candid insights and practical tips for juggling business, motherhood, finances, and self-care. Through personal stories and strategies, Nakisha inspires women to create fulfilling lives while embracing imperfection and pursuing their dreams.

feeds.title: Adoptive Black Mom
feeds.description: Adoptive Black Mom, a professional single mother, shares her poignant journey of adoption. At 39, she embraced motherhood alone, defying societal norms. Now at 50, she reflects on the potholes and joys of parenting, offering insights and solace to others navigating similar paths.

feeds.title: Plan B Chronicles
feeds.description: Plan B Chronicles blog chronicles the journey of a Single Professional Black Woman as she navigates motherhood and beyond. With candid reflections and insights, her story resonates with readers on a deeply personal level, offering inspiration and solidarity along the way.
